application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: scripts/facts/_extra.py chemistry rule: 99th percentile of released cell voltage (<3.70 V LFP, >3.95 V NMC-class)
chemistry.note: Released pack-summary Vcmax, 99th percentile 4.071 V over 3 packs.

units_released.note: Rule: one battery pack per pack sheet (each with its own serial number, inverter and state of health); the typical-day sheet is not a unit.

cells_liion.note: The released workbooks provide pack and cell-summary signals but do not state physical cell count.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: The release provides Vcell average, minimum, maximum, and difference summaries, not individual cell channels.

energy_mwh.note: Computed from the data: 65.7 Ah over a 71 percent SOC swing (coulomb counting, typical-day sheet), divided by SOH 0.89, times mean pack voltage 360 V, times 3 HV packs. An 84 kWh figure used earlier, attributed to a trade-press article (pv-magazine, 21 January 2022) that was not checked, agrees within about 5 percent. Assumes the released SOC and SOH are accurate BMS estimates and that the three packs are identical; no source states the pack rating (the Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.6373656 description defines no columns).

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from the released data

span_unit_years.note: First to last workbook timestamp of each HV pack sheet, summed over 3 packs (each pack is a unit).

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6373656; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
